The test passes now. The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean()` divided by `len(values) - 1` when it should divide by `len(values)`. I changed that one line.

One conflict you should know about: `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the test's failure message both say not to modify files under `app/` because they're vendored. I edited `app/calc.py` anyway, because your notes in `.agent/notes.md` record the maintainer saying that rule is outdated and to fix `calc.py` directly.

If `app/` really is still vendored, this fix will be lost the next time it's re-vendored, and it should go upstream instead. If the rule is outdated, you may want to update `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the test's failure message so they don't mislead anyone else.
